name: Dedicated Melee Slot
description: Carry a pistol and a melee weapon at once. Pick the melee (machete, stun-lance, saber, stun-baton, hatchet or shovel) from a small box on the player card, or by name in melee-slot-weapon.txt: it rides in the secondary slot beside your pistol, and tapping 2 again while the secondary is drawn toggles between them in about half a second. Survives death and respawn. Does nothing until a melee is set. The pick box needs Bingus Shared Loader v15+ (loaded last).
